query:
SELECT 
  productName,
  expiryDate,
  quantity,
  costPrice,
  (costPrice * quantity) as value
FROM inventory 
WHERE DATE(createdAt) = '2026-04-26'
  AND (productName LIKE '%Azithromycin%' OR productName LIKE '%Doxycycline%' OR productName LIKE '%Amoxicillin%')
ORDER BY productName;
